## Change

Describe the invariant changed and the evidence that exercises it.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran `make check` from a clean checkout.
- [ ] I added or updated deterministic tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I inspected generated files and the staged diff.

## Safety and claims

- [ ] The change contains no secret, credential, private trace, or sensitive artifact.
- [ ] Documentation separates measured evidence from targets and scopes every benchmark claim.
- [ ] Synthetic results are not presented as external efficacy evidence.
